audit.why: This is the one mid matchup where Kassadin's passive is dead weight: Void Stone reduces magic damage and Zed's Razor Shuriken, Shadow Slash and Death Mark are physical. Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage specifically, so it absorbs nothing Zed throws. 46.94% over 1666 games is the only losing matchup in this slice, and TRICKY 7/10 understates it slightly but is defensible.

Zed's spikes are level 3 (Living Shadow plus Shadow Slash on 5s), level 6 Death Mark at 120s, and lethality items. Kassadin's are 6, Rod of Ages and 16. The spikes[] timings on the page match those; only their text was wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six writable fields tell you to SILENCE Zed with Null Sphere, or that a silence shuts his combo down. Kassadin has no silence. One field also tells you to build magic resist against him.
audit.why: Null Sphere's text is damage, a channel interrupt, and a magic shield — no silence, and no silence flag in the kit. Death Mark is a dash with untargetability, not a channel, so there is nothing for the interrupt to catch either. Separately, every Zed ability is physical, so magic resist is the wrong stat and Zhonya's / armour is the right one. The interaction that IS real: Death Mark's mark 'repeats a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked' over 3 seconds, so Riftwalking out of his reach during those 3s shrinks what the mark repeats.
audit.corrected: Silence claims removed from spikes[0].text, spikes[3].text, late, whys[6], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[2]; the MR advice replaced with armour in late and wants.you[3]; the 3-second mark mechanic written into breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[3].text.

audit.why: Death Mark is 120/110/100s and Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16s — the two timers this lane is played on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemisation advice pointed at magic resist and Void Staff as the answer to his burst.
audit.why: Zed deals physical damage; Void Staff is magic penetration and helps you kill him, not survive him. Zhonya's is the item that answers a 3-second mark.
audit.corrected: wants.you[3] and late now name armour and Zhonya's.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Check it before every step-up. - R Riftwalk is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, and the mark fires 3s after it lands repeating only what he deals inside those 3s; Riftwalk clear and it fizzles. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1 — that is his escape too.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Force Pulse charges off every spell cast near you, and Zed casts Shadow Slash every 5s — the slow is always paid for in this lane.

edits.before: Zed whiffs Death Mark and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Zed whiffs Death Mark — that is 120s at rank 1 of lane.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: Every extra Riftwalk doubles the cost — the stack you take at low HP leaves nothing for escaping the mark.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zed wins by opening on a 20s Living Shadow, stacking damage inside the 3s mark, and killing you before Rod of Ages.

edits.before: Full-build magic resist plus a well-timed silence neutralizes his burst and lets your scaling win out.
edits.after: Full-build armor and Zhonya's blunt his physical burst, and your scaling takes it from there.

edits.before: Zed's Shadow-Slash-into-Death-Mark burst deletes squishy Kassadin before you have Void Stone MP restore or R up, and your only defensive tool (Q silence) has too short a range to stop his shadow-swap engage.
edits.after: Zed's Shadow Slash into Death Mark deletes a squishy Kassadin before you have Rod of Ages or R, and Null Sphere's shield only absorbs magic — it does nothing about a shadow-swap opening on a 20s cooldown.

edits.before: Full-build Kassadin double-Riftwalks past his shadow engage, silences his Death Mark cast with Null Sphere if you time the interrupt, and out-damages him through raw magic pen his kit can't itemize against.
edits.after: Full-build Kassadin double-Riftwalks past his shadow engage, leaves the Death Mark radius before the 3s mark repeats anything worth repeating, and out-damages a kit that must spend 120s to open on you.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you can trade Null Sphere pokes safely, but the instant Zed hits level 3 his Shadow Slash-Q-shadow combo threatens a full burst rotation you cannot out-trade or out-sustain, so you're forced into a passive farming pattern behind minions until 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 you can trade Null Sphere pokes safely, but the instant Zed hits level 3 his Living Shadow into Shadow Slash and Razor Shuriken threatens a full burst rotation you cannot out-trade or out-sustain, so you farm passively behind minions until 6.

edits.before: With Void Staff and enough magic resist Zed's Death Mark damage stops one-shotting you, and a well-timed Null Sphere silence on his engage window shuts his combo down completely, letting your scaling damage and double-blink mobility take over the matchup.
edits.after: With Zhonya's and enough armor Zed's Death Mark stops one-shotting you — his whole kit is physical, so magic resist buys you nothing here — and Riftwalking clear inside the 3s mark denies the repeat, letting your scaling and double-blink mobility take over.

edits.before: Save Q to interrupt his shadow-return dash or Death Mark cast when possible
edits.after: Save Null Sphere's shield for the instant after the mark lands, not before

edits.before: Scale into Void Staff/Zhonya's where his burst stops one-shotting you
edits.after: Build Zhonya's and armor rather than MR — his whole kit is physical

edits.before: Bait your Q silence on a shadow clone before committing the real dash
edits.after: Bait your Null Sphere onto a shadow clone before he commits the dash

notes: Two systematic errors ran through this matchup. (1) Six fields told the player to SILENCE Zed with Null Sphere; Kassadin has no silence in the current kit — Riot's text gives Null Sphere damage, a channel interrupt and a magic shield. Death Mark is a dash with untargetability, not a channel, so there is nothing to interrupt either, and 'time the interrupt on his Death Mark cast' is advice that gets a player killed while they stand still holding Q. (2) Two fields told the player to build magic resist and Void Staff against a champion whose entire kit is physical; corrected to armour and Zhonya's. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Void Staff' in wants.you[3] — the tool caught the right field for the wrong reason: Void Staff is a real item, it is just the wrong item here. It also flagged 'Shadow Slash-' in early, which is a hyphenation artifact of a combo string; that field is rewritten anyway.
